overview: The Medford City Council met to vote on licensing, committee reports, community resolutions, parking enforcement on private ways near Mystic Lakes, and Community Preservation Act allocations. The Council also reappointed the City Clerk, heard public testimony on the Columbus School renaming process, and approved supplemental appropriations for the cemetery.

items.title: Reappointment of City Clerk (Paper 21-398)
items.summary: Accepted a Committee of the Whole report recommending the reappointment of City Clerk Adam Hurtubise for a three-year term.

items.title: Committee Report on Budget Hearings (Paper 21-403)
items.summary: Accepted Committee of the Whole reports regarding ongoing deliberations on the city budget.

items.title: Common Victualler License for Greenfield Pizza (Paper 21-419)
items.summary: Approved a common victualler license for Ellerton Victor de Oliveira to operate Greenfield Pizza at 399 Main Street.

items.title: Resolution on Residential Irrigation Meters (Paper 21-413)
items.summary: Passed a resolution requesting the Water and Sewer Commission to consider expanding second water meter benefits to all residents and commercial properties and to evaluate Revere's spigot meter program.

items.title: Commendation for Retiring Deputy Fire Chief Brian Cronin (Paper 21-414)
items.summary: Approved a resolution congratulating Deputy Chief of Operations Brian Cronin on his retirement after 42 years of service with the Medford Fire Department.

items.title: Recognition of Bella Capelli Salon 15th Anniversary (Paper 21-415)
items.summary: Approved a resolution recognizing owner Maria Ryan-Essa on the 15th anniversary of Bella Capelli Salon.

items.title: Parking Enforcement and Regulations on Private Ways Near Mystic Lakes (Paper 21-416)
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting ordinance language, temporary weekend signage, and state agency coordination to enforce resident-only parking and address overcrowding and trash near Mystic Lakes.

items.title: Resolution on Expanded Child Tax Credit Outreach (Paper 21-417)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting city and school administration outreach regarding the expanded federal Child Tax Credit and commended the Medford Family Network.

items.title: Public Participation on School Renaming and Building Naming Authority
items.summary: Residents expressed concerns regarding the Columbus School renaming process, prompting a proposed motion to ask the City Solicitor if an ordinance can grant the City Council oversight over municipal and school building naming.

items.title: Cemetery Supplemental Appropriations (Paper 21-420)
items.summary: Approved supplemental appropriations totaling $273,948.10 from perpetual care interest and grave sale accounts for cemetery operations.

items.title: FY22 Community Preservation Act Revenues and Appropriations (Paper 21-421)
items.summary: Approved the FY22 Community Preservation Committee recommended allocation of $2,047,125 across open space, community housing, historic preservation, administration, and reserves.
